headline: OpenAI and HP Inc. expand partnership for AI deployment across enterprise operations.

items.title: HP Inc. launches Frontier strategic partnership with OpenAI
items.summary: HP Inc. expands its strategic partnership with OpenAI, known as Frontier, to enhance AI capabilities across customer experiences, software development, and enterprise operations. The partnership aims to leverage OpenAI's technologies to streamline processes and drive innovation within HP's operations. This strategic move is expected to accelerate AI adoption at scale, providing a competitive edge in the digital transformation landscape.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads should note the increased integration of AI in enterprise environments, which could influence AI tool development and deployment strategies.

items.title: LongCat-2.0, a large-scale MoE model with 1.6T total and 48B Active
items.summary: LongCat-2.0, a new model of experts (MoE) architecture, boasts 1.6 trillion parameters in total with 48 billion active parameters. This release promises significant advancements in handling complex computations and large-scale data processing, making it a compelling choice for projects requiring extensive AI computations.

items.title: Ornith-1.0: self-improving open-source models for agentic coding
items.summary: Ornith-1.0 introduces self-improving models specifically designed for agentic coding tasks. These open-source models are released under the MIT license, providing developers with the flexibility to adapt and enhance them for various coding applications, thus fostering innovation in AI-driven coding solutions.

items.title: Internalizing the Future: A Unified Agentic Training Paradigm for World Model Planning
items.summary: This research discusses how large language model agents can be trained to improve decision-making over long horizons by employing 'what-if' reasoning. The paradigm aims to make these models more proactive rather than reactive, potentially enhancing their utility in complex planning tasks.

items.title: Towards Reliable and Robust LLM Planning: Symbolic Feedback-Driven Iterative Self-Refinement Framework
items.summary: Proposes a new framework to enhance the robustness and reliability of large language models in planning tasks. This framework uses symbolic feedback to iteratively refine models, addressing security concerns and improving planning accuracy, which is crucial for deploying reliable AI systems.

all_items.title: Multi-tenant LLM analytics with row-level security: How we built a secure agent on AWS
all_items.summary: In this post, we show you how PAR built a production-ready multi-tenant LLM analytics system that enforces row-level security through a three-layer architecture: cryptographic request signing with AWS SigV4, semantic validation on Amazon Bedrock, and programmatic data isolation via Split-Plane SQL. We demonstrate how each layer operates independently to reduce the risk of cross-tenant data exposure, even when the LLM itself is compromised or manipulated.

all_items.title: Debugging production agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability
all_items.summary: In this post, you learn how to debug production agent failures using built-in observability capabilities. We walk through common failure patterns, show how to analyze agent behavior with traces and metrics, and provide structured workflows for resolving issues such as infinite loops and tool invocation failures. This is Part 1 of a two-part series. Part 2 covers performance optimization and memory management.
